changes.production_binding: CurrentProcessXLivePipePreimageHost implements both providers through actual source addresses.
changes.allocation: Default initialization leaves actual payload unwritten. unique_ptr owns new context until provider/copy succeed; provider throw frees it before original exception propagation.
changes.temporary: Default-initialized actual Wide local; create/store lock first; capture payload and copy observed representation back. Provider throw deletes actual lock flags1. Native transform exception semantics unchanged.
changes.random: Real API receives an uninitialized local8 buffer. Capture immediately after API into output, including partial failure writes and untouched remainder; mark all8 bytes known, preserve BOOL and LastError.
changes.random_provider: Removed unused random method from FramePreimageHost. SystemHost recording-input method retained; Win32 returns unknown carrier never passed to real API.
changes.construction_compatibility: Win32 protocol/frame system-host constructor signatures still take their existing provider host references.

representation.encoded_dependency: Only low2 bits of each encoded preimage byte affect recovered transforms. All8 actual bits are captured into fully written C++ bytes.
representation.random_dependency: All64 bits of raw8 API output/preimage are consumed; encoded low2-bit rule does not apply.

capture_fixture_cases: actual allocated object address passed to provider
default initialization preserves known fixture payload patterns
actual captured allocation representation copied back unchanged
heap allocation freed exactly once on provider throw
real compiled Win32 random method with recording IAT binding: partial failure writes2 bytes and leaves6 untouched
all8 observed bytes and exact BOOL/error preserved on failure
recorded success writes all8 and preserves exact status/error

fixture_import_boundary: Only the ignored fixture executable temporarily replaces its own CryptGenRandom IAT slot with a synchronous recording function, then restores the original slot. Production always forwards to the real import.
remaining_contracts: Caller preserves valid buffer/global/host lifetimes and native transform preconditions.
Recording providers are explicit fixture inputs, not production traces.
Capture leaf uses compiler-specific machine semantics and assumes valid storage; no fake success on invalid pointers.
Native frame/pipe endpoint compatibility remains a separate runtime validation boundary.
